Map a target R0 (or Rt(t) series) to beta_community via final-size data

Source: R/time_varying_transmission_calibration.R
get_beta_from_R0_finalsize.Rd

Prints a summary of the transmission fractions used in the underlying sweep, the results table, and a plot of the mapped beta_community values across the target sequence, then returns that same table.

Usage

get_beta_from_R0_finalsize(
  target,
  sweep_db,
  linear_threshold = 1.2,
  min_linear_points = 3L
)

Arguments

target

Numeric scalar (a single target R0) or numeric vector (an Rt(t) time series). Values > 1 are interpolated against the final-size table; values <= 1 use a linear extrapolation fit to swept points near the epidemic threshold (see linear_threshold and min_linear_points).

sweep_db

Either the list object returned by run_beta_sweep(), or a file path (character string) to an .rds file saved by it.

linear_threshold

R0 value defining the upper boundary of the near-threshold region used to fit the linear extrapolation. All swept points with R0 <= linear_threshold are used if there are at least min_linear_points of them; otherwise the min_linear_points swept points closest to R0 = 1 are used instead. Default 1.2.

min_linear_points

Minimum number of points required in the near-threshold region before falling back to the closest-points approach. Default 3.

Value

A data.frame with one row per element of target, and columns:

  • index: position within target (useful for an Rt(t) series)

  • target_R0: the R0 or Rt value supplied

  • beta_community: the corresponding beta_community value

  • source: "sweep_data" if target_R0 > 1 (interpolated directly from the sweep), or "linear_extrapolation" if target_R0 <= 1

Details

Note: this method assumes a fully susceptible population. When applied to an Rt(t) series, each value is looked up independently against the static beta-R0 relationship and does not account for time-varying susceptible depletion interacting with a changing Rt.

See also

Other calibration: generate_beta_sweep_plot(), generate_time_varying_beta_vectors(), get_R0_from_attack_rate(), get_sweep_result_from_source(), run_beta_sweep(), run_one_sweep_replicate()
